subject: Request to substitute a linear slot alternate diffuser in lieu of the specified

messages.text: We would like to substitute a linear slot alternate diffuser in lieu of the specified perforated face diffuser, per Section 23 30 00. This is becoming a priority given current lead times. The substitution may result in a credit or an added cost depending on the manufacturer. No schedule impact is anticipated from this substitution. Please respond within five business days so we can place the order.
